text:
glasses_felix: Highly variable and unpredictable. Day 19 AM (09:42) was bathroom_shelf_ba1; Day 19 AM (10:48) was coffee_table_l1; Day 18 AM was coffee_table_l1; Day 17 AM was nightstand_b1; Day 17 evening was desk_b1. Stop assuming any single location. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1, coffee_table_l1, nightstand_b1, and desk_b1.

tablet_felix: Variable. Day 19 PM (17:17) was coffee_table_l1; Day 18 PM (17:32) was kitchen_table_k1; Day 16 AM was coffee_table_l1. Stop assuming kitchen_table_k1 for afternoon. Check coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1 for afternoon/evening.

book_felix: Consistently at coffee_table_l1 in the afternoon. Day 16 AM, Day 15, and Day 14 were all coffee_table_l1. Stop assuming couch_l1. Check coffee_table_l1.

mug_felix: Variable. Day 18 AM (10:23) was coffee_table_l1; Day 17 evening was kitchen_table_k1; Day 16 PM was kitchen_table_k1. Stop assuming cupboard_k1. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning/afternoon, kitchen_table_k1 for evening.

glass_felix: Variable. Day 18 evening (22:59) was kitchen_table_k1; Day 16 evening was cupboard_k1; Day 15 evening was counter_k1. Stop assuming cupboard_k1 is the only evening spot. Check kitchen_table_k1, counter_k1, and cupboard_k1 in the evening.

razor_felix: Persistent morning error. Assumed sink_ba_ba1; actually at bathroom_shelf_ba1 on Day 15, 14, 13, and 7. Stop checking the sink for morning queries; check bathroom_shelf_ba1.

water_bottle_felix: Persistent afternoon error. Assumed dish_rack_k1; actually at coffee_table_l1 on Day 18 (09:54), Day 15, and Day 14. Stop checking dish_rack_k1 or entry_floor_e1. Check coffee_table_l1 for water bottles in the morning/afternoon.
